clifft_legacy.role: last legacy-default Clifft SVM before the sampler cutover

symft.notes: AVX2 and AVX-512 kernels were also compiled in separate ISA-specific translation units.

protocol.observable_contract: retain observable 0 only; add observable 0 from final record when absent
protocol.reference_contract: one explicit Clifft noiseless reference vector passed to every arm
protocol.ordering: 12 balanced process-level rounds; backend order rotated each round
protocol.warmup: up to 1000 shots per process, excluded from timing
protocol.output: survivor counts with observable 0, detector postselection where applicable
protocol.seed_pairing: new seed per round, shared across backend positions
protocol.reference_timing: shared noiseless reference-vector calculation excluded from compile time
